name: aitrends-3d-studio
description: Turn a script into a finished 3D animated story video: channel identity kit, script check, emotional open-source voiceover (Chatterbox, Kokoro fallback), word timings, story breakdown, set match against the kit's catalogue (asks before adding missing sets to the plugin), code-built 3D sets (home: teen bedroom, kitchen, living room, phone close-up; city, school, American high school (library, chem lab, auditorium, football field, locker room, band room, principal, nurse, prom, diner), weight room, climbing gym, breakable stadium light tower, livestream corner, stairwell, classroom, bus stop, shop street, residential street, street food, café, home, beach, island, snow, farm, underwater, space) and stick characters (Three.js), glossy materials, mirror floors, sky domes and light shafts, light from props, game HUD, first-person shots, animated explainer diagrams, style and palette choice, frame-by-frame render up to 4K / 60 fps, generated music and SFX, quality scorecard, final MP4.
